verdict.rationale: AvaTax documents a broad REST v2 API with SDKs in six languages, covering transaction creation, nexus declaration and address validation. An MCP server also exposes tax calculation, transaction management and nexus handling. The evidence never states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that every UI capability is available through the API, coverage of admin/settings/reporting operations via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
